verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs thoroughly document typed tool definitions, strict schema validation, parallel tool calling by default, fine-grained tool streaming, and structured/validated JSON outputs for agent workflows, plus multi-step agent loop support via the Messages API, code/bash/browser/computer-use tools, and MCP connectors — enough to build a robust agent loop. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on benchmark or third-party confirmation of tool-calling reliability/accuracy in practice (community evidence is about pricing/performance quality, not tool-calling fidelity specifically).
